1. A person icon indicating user profile or account.
2. A Facebook icon indicating a notification from the Facebook app.
3. A circular icon with an "i" indicating an information or system update.
4. A crossed-out bell icon indicating that notifications are silenced.
5. A battery icon with a lightning bolt indicating charging status.
